tours.name: A Negative Wage on a Contract

name_i18n.en_US: A Negative Wage on a Contract

tours.description: Learn what the contract form does with a negative wage, without saving anything.

description_i18n.en_US: Learn what the contract form does with a negative wage, without saving anything.

steps.title: Open Employees
steps.description: Contracts are managed from the Employees app.

description_i18n.en_US: Contracts are managed from the Employees app.

steps.title: Employees menu
steps.description: The Employees menu holds the employee list and the contracts.

description_i18n.en_US: The Employees menu holds the employee list and the contracts.

steps.title: Contracts
steps.description: Every contract of every employee is listed here.

description_i18n.en_US: Every contract of every employee is listed here.

steps.title: New
steps.content: Click New to start a contract.

content_i18n.en_US: Click New to start a contract.

steps.description: The form opens empty. This practice is never saved.

description_i18n.en_US: The form opens empty. This practice is never saved.

steps.title: Type a negative wage
steps.description: Odoo does not stop you from typing a negative amount in the field, because the wage is only a number. Always check the figure before you save: a negative wage would produce a negative payslip.

description_i18n.en_US: Odoo does not stop you from typing a negative amount in the field, because the wage is only a number. Always check the figure before you save: a negative wage would produce a negative payslip.

steps.title: Check the wage
steps.content: Look at the wage. Click the field to continue.

content_i18n.en_US: Look at the wage. Click the field to continue.

steps.description: The minus sign is kept. In real data the wage should be positive.

description_i18n.en_US: The minus sign is kept. In real data the wage should be positive.

steps.title: Discard
steps.content: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

content_i18n.en_US: Click the discard icon to leave without saving.

steps.description: Nothing was stored, so this practice leaves no trace. Fill in the required fields and save if you want to keep a real record.

description_i18n.en_US: Nothing was stored, so this practice leaves no trace. Fill in the required fields and save if you want to keep a real record.
